method: walked every published ledger entry; parsed proof_event.content; NIP-01 id recomputed and schnorr-verified for all 240 proof events before any field was counted
invariant: Across the 8 policy_versions that shipped a live proof (v4-v18, 214 signed proofs of 240 walked), the preimage field set is monotonic: no observed version drops a field present in an earlier observed version.
note_v19: invinoveritas.review.v19 (23 fields, the version supplied in wg-identity#21) does not appear in the 262-entry public ledger.

coverage.note: This walk sees only versions that shipped a LIVE proof to the public ledger. v12-v16 is a contiguous blind spot: the last observation before it (v11) carries no action_binding fields and the first after it (v17) carries all four, so every intermediate step is unwitnessed.

known_exception.source: POLICY_VERSION_AUTHORIZED_PREIMAGE_FIELDS — the producer-side registry /verify-proof checks against, not the public ledger
known_exception.what: v13's single `action_binding_hash` was split into `action_binding_tool_hash`, `action_binding_args_hash` and `action_binding_agent_id` at v14.
known_exception.classification: Rename/split, not a semantic drop — the binding it committed to is still committed, at finer granularity.
known_exception.why_this_walk_missed_it: v13 never shipped a live proof before the split (28 minutes apart in the same commit session), so it is inside the v12-v16 blind spot above. The public ledger is structurally incapable of witnessing a version that never published.
known_exception.consistent_with_our_data: Yes and necessarily so: v11 (observed) has no action_binding field of any kind and v17 (observed) has all four, so our evidence is silent on the transition rather than contradicting it.

limitation: A ledger walk bounds what was ISSUED, never what was REGISTERED. A field set that was registered and never used leaves no trace here. Treat this file as the observed lower bound on policy-version history, and the operator's registry as the authority on the rest.
